ai_content.desc_en: Ming Dynasty is a historical drama series that revolves around the life of Sun Ruo Wei, who was forced to leave her family after Emperor Yongle ordered their execution in 1402. Sun Ruo Wei became the concubine of Crown Prince Zhu Zhan Ji by chance and continued to investigate the truth behind her family's death. Over time, Sun Ruo Wei's intentions changed and she decided to become a virtuous empress to support her husband, Zhu Zhan Ji.
